description: This file defines a Java class 'Triangle' for use in an OpenGL ES 2.0 context on Android. It encapsulates the setup and rendering of a 2D triangle shape, including shader code, buffer initialization, and drawing routines.

classes.name: Triangle
classes.description: A class representing a 2D triangle object for rendering in OpenGL ES 2.0 on Android. It manages shader programs, buffers, and the draw routine.

methods.name: Triangle
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the shaders, buffers, and program needed to render the triangle.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Encapsulates the OpenGL ES instructions to draw the triangle with the provided Model View Projection matrix.
